securityNotes: Single-file prose skill (SKILL.md only, ~40 lines, no scripts/binaries/references). Frontmatter uses only name+description. No network calls, no credential access, no download-and-execute, no hidden or user-rule-bypassing instructions. Read in full at the pinned commit via a local codeload tarball extraction.

proposedEntry.name: heuristic-evaluation
proposedEntry.description: Runs an expert-review heuristic evaluation of an interface against Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics (visibility of system status, match with the real world, user control and freedom, consistency, error prevention, recognition over recall, flexibility and efficiency, aesthetic and minimalist design, error recovery, help and documentation). Instructs using multiple evaluators and merging findings, rating severity, citing the specific screen/element/heuristic violated, and pairing with user research at high stakes. Ends with a verification checklist confirming findings are heuristic-tied, severity-rated and actionable.
triggers: audit this UI against Nielsen's heuristics
